title: Constant etale sections on affine space are detected on the zero section
statement:
Let $S$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $d\geq0$, and put $P=\mathbf A^d_S$ with projection $p:P\to S$ [def-sbc-affine-space] and zero section $e:S\to P$ (on every affine chart all coordinates are sent to zero). Let $E$ be any abelian group. Let $\underline E_S$ and $\underline E_P$ be the sheafifications of the constant presheaves with value $E$ on the ordinary small etale sites of $S$ and $P$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Use the canonical inverse-image identifications of these constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, lemma-constructible-pullback-constant]. Then pullback of sections gives mutually inverse isomorphisms
$$p^*: \Gamma(S,\underline E_S)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(P,\underline E_P),\qquad e^*: \Gamma(P,\underline E_P)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(S,\underline E_S).$$
Equivalently, under the identification of sections with Zariski-locally constant functions [lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-sections-locally-constant], every such function $b:|P|\to E$ satisfies $b=(b\circ|e|)\circ|p|$. These inverse isomorphisms commute with pullback along every morphism $S'\to S$ and the corresponding maps $\mathbf A^d_{S'}\to\mathbf A^d_S$. In particular, for a commutative ring $A$, a unit section $b\in\Gamma(P,A_P)^\times$ with $e^*b=1$ equals $1$ on $P$. Empty or disconnected bases and $d=0$ are included; no finiteness assumption on $E$ is imposed.

proof.text: Give E the discrete topology and evaluate the canonical constant-sheaf/continuous-map sheaf isomorphism occurring in [lem-weil-pbc-constant-pullback-unit-continuous-map] at the chosen terminal etale object. Identify its underlying scheme with S using the unique isomorphism to the identity etale object. This gives an additive equivalence between actual terminal-object sections and continuous E-valued functions on S. Naturality of the comparison, followed by the cited pullback formula, identifies the actual section pullback with precomposition by the given scheme morphism. The terminal-object pushforward comparison is the restriction along the inverse of PreservesTerminal.iso; the pullback square and the over-category morphism equation identify the resulting underlying map with the original morphism. Continuous maps to a discrete space are locally constant. This uses the already proved canonical continuous-map comparison directly, so no comparison between separately chosen locally constant-section equivalences is required.

source.place: Step 1: locally constant unit section, with Stacks 03P5 (remark-constant-locally-constant-maps) for sections

proof.text: Let $b:|P|\to E$ be locally constant and fix $x\in|P|$. Put $s=|p|(x)$ and $F_s=|p|^{-1}(\{s\})$. By [lem-pur-affine-projection-connected-fibres], $F_s$ is connected. The points $x$ and $|e|(s)$ both belong to $F_s$: the latter follows from $p\circ e=1_S$. Indeed, on an affine chart the composite ring map sends each coefficient to itself, by the coordinate description [def-sbc-affine-space] and the zero-coordinate definition of $e$.

source.place: Step 1: connected fibres and the zero section

proof.text: Apply Mathlib LocallyConstant.apply_eq_of_isPreconnected to the preconnected fibre in Step 2 and its two points. This is the fibrewise clopen-locus argument: the equality fibre of b is open and closed, contains the zero-section point, and must contain x. Thus b(x)=b(e(p(x))) for every x, for arbitrary coefficient types, without a topology or algebraic structure on those coefficients.

source.place: Step 1: the clopen locus contains the zero section and hence every fibre

proof.text: Write P=p* and Q=e* for the actual additive section maps. The precomposition formula of Step 1 and e followed by p equal to the identity show Q(P(a))=a. Convert the continuous function representing b into a locally constant function and apply Step 3 to show P(Q(b))=b. These maps therefore define the required additive equivalence with exactly the two prescribed homomorphisms. For any commutative ring A and any unit b of the locally constant A-valued functions, apply Step 3 to its underlying function. The hypothesis makes b(x)=b(e(p(x)))=1 at every point. Function extensionality and injectivity of the coercion from units imply b=1.

source.place: Step 1: deduction of zero-section detection, including the unit section

proof.text: For a base-change morphism g:S-prime to S, use the existing coordinate identities AffineSpace.map_over and AffineSpace.zeroSection_comp_map from [def-sbc-affine-space]. Apply the injective continuous-function comparison in Step 1 to each section in the two proposed naturality squares. Repeated application of the precomposition formula reduces the first square to h followed by p equal to p-prime followed by g, and the second to e-prime followed by h equal to g followed by e. These are precisely the two coordinate identities. No step uses nonemptiness or connectedness of S, positive dimension, or finite coefficients, so the empty, disconnected and zero-dimensional cases are included.

lean.statement: theorem affine_constant_section_zero_detection (S : Scheme.{u}) (d : ℕ) (E : Type (u + 1)) [AddCommGroup E] : (∃ φ : affineConstantSections S E ≃+ affineConstantSections (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S) E, φ.toAddMonoidHom = (affineConstantSectionPullback (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S ↘ S) E).hom ∧ φ.symm.toAddMonoidHom = (affineConstantSectionPullback (AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S) E).hom) ∧ (∀ b : LocallyConstant (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S) E, ∀ x : AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S, b x = b ((AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S) ((AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S ↘ S) x))) ∧ (∀ (S' : Scheme.{u}) (g : S' ⟶ S), (affineConstantSectionPullback (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S ↘ S) E) ≫ (affineConstantSectionPullback (AffineSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) g) E) = (affineConstantSectionPullback g E) ≫ (affineConstantSectionPullback (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S' ↘ S') E) ∧ (affineConstantSectionPullback (AffineSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) g) E) ≫ (affineConstantSectionPullback (AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S') E) = (affineConstantSectionPullback (AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S) E) ≫ (affineConstantSectionPullback g E)) ∧ (∀ (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (b : (LocallyConstant (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S) A)ˣ), (∀ s : S, (b : LocallyConstant (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S) A) ((AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S) s) = 1) → b = 1)
